entries.summary: V2 had partial event search and deduplication; missing real-time dates, daily summary, future view and unified historical query were identified.
Guardian history had 619 lines with cycle boundaries and imported Git history; unified before/after evidence was identified as a needed improvement.
Memory/history components were identified as fragmented, with a need for a unified autobiographical mechanism.
Requested dated memory and journal records for every development step; repository development-journal infrastructure followed.
Requested full-history review and autonomous continuation; stewardship loop was defined as observe, compare, identify gaps, change, test, verify, document, reassess.
